Can you recommend the suitable data speed or bandwidth required for each [product_name] to ensure reliable web server communication? Thank you! [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user requests advice on the necessary data speed or bandwidth for stable web server communication in a setup involving multiple [product_name] controllers. Official documentation does not clearly state the communication requirements, leading to uncertainty during remote monitoring system design.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks clear guidance or official specifications regarding data speed or bandwidth per device to achieve reliable web server performance with multiple [product_name] controllers.
